L1328@P12: Running arkworks’s benchmark suite on both versions found
L1329@P12: minimal performance differences; see Appendix A for details.
L1330@P12: We also compared against state-of-the-art industrial proof
L1331@P12: systems Halo217 and Plonky218, but they could not scale to
L1332@P12: large instances, and so we omitted comparisons against them.

L1337@P12: Experimental setups. We ran our experiments on an AWS
L1338@P12: EC2 i3en.3xlarge instance with an Intel Xeon Platinum
L1339@P12: 8175 CPU with 12 cores at 3.1GHz, 7.5TiB of storage, and
